newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecoms bill to reach Congress soon-report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecoms bill to reach Congress soon-report.

text.p: A bill to regulate the break-up of Brazil's telecommunications monopoly should arrive in the Congress after the second round of municipal elections on November 15, private Invest News agency said.

Citing Inocencio Oliveira, leader of the Liberal Front Party (PFL) in the lower house, Invest News said the text of the bill will be put to the vote by the lower house Science and Technology Committee by the end of the year before moving to the Congress in January.

Oliveira, whom Invest News said had received news of the bill after lunching with Telecommunications Minister Sergio Motta, said Motta meant to begin privatisation of subsidiaries of Brazil's federally-owned Telebras by May next year.

However, another deputy, Arolde de Oliveira, said that it would be impossible to begin the privatisation process in May and that voting on the project would only likely be completed in Congress by the end of 1997.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
